item.title: Cost of Living in Keilor Melbourne
item.description:
Before committing to Keilor, run the numbers. Rent is just the start - here is the complete cost breakdown.

Read our full Keilor suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Keilor Expensive?

Keilor sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Keilor, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Getting Around Keilor — Transport Guide
item.description:
Real talk about getting around Keilor: what the timetable says vs what actually happens.

Check out our full Keilor suburb guide for the complete picture.

Getting Around Keilor — The Quick Version

Public transport in Keilor is decent. You can get to the city in roughly 30 to 50 minutes during peak hours. Having a car helps, especially for weekend errands and trips outside the PT network.

Train Access

Keilor is served by train, though you may need to get to the nearest station which can be a short walk or bus ride away.

item.title: Keilor Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
